name: Data Clumps
description: Groups of variables that appear together in multiple places in the code. These repeated groups of variables should be extracted into their own classes.

refactoringTechniques.name: Extract Class
refactoringTechniques.description: Create a new class to hold the clumped data and provide appropriate access methods.

refactoringTechniques.name: Introduce Parameter Object
refactoringTechniques.description: Replace the clump of parameters with a single parameter object.

refactoringTechniques.name: Preserve Whole Object
refactoringTechniques.description: Pass the complete object that contains the data clump instead of passing individual fields.
